name: Abha International Airport — Truce-Ending Strike
detail: Houthi ballistic missiles and drones struck Abha Airport, Saudi Arabia, Jul 13, 2026 — first claimed attack on Saudi soil since the informal 2022 truce. All projectiles intercepted, no casualties.

name: Tankers Encelia & Layla, Red Sea
detail: Houthi missiles and drones struck two Saudi-linked oil tankers Jul 23, 2026, sparking fires; no casualties, all crew safe. Brent crude hit $100/bbl same day.

name: Jazan Refinery — Gasification Unit & Tank Farm
detail: First direct Houthi strike on Saudi oil infrastructure of the 2026 escalation. Refinery went offline in the aftermath.

name: Marib & Hadramout Government Camps
detail: Ballistic missiles and drones from Al-Jawf hit Homeland Shield, Emergency Forces and First Military Region camps — 30-58 government troops killed, deadliest single episode of the conflict in years.

name: Najran, Saudi Arabia — 11 Wounded
detail: Houthi projectiles wounded 11 civilians in Najran — highest civilian toll inside the Kingdom in 4+ years. Signed same day as the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement.

name: Jazan Refinery — Second Drone Strike
detail: Drone strike sparked a fire at the 400,000 bpd refinery, extinguished by dawn, no injuries. Houthis cited alleged Saudi drone incursions into Saada and Hajjah as justification.

name: Al-Makha Port — First August Strike
detail: Houthi missiles/drones killed 7 at al-Makha port; Houthis say they targeted Saudi-backed force and 'mercenary' buildups.

name: Cargo Ship Tihamah — Double-Tap Strike, Bab al-Mandeb
detail: 6 killed (4 crew, 2 rescuers) in a double-tap strike — first fatal Houthi attack on shipping since the Iran war began. Houthis claimed the ship carried Saudi military equipment.

name: Al-Makha Port — Second August Strike
detail: Six ballistic missiles hit al-Makha; government says 4-8 killed including 2 security personnel, fishing boats set ablaze.

name: Marib Displacement Camps
detail: Six ballistic missiles and four drones struck residential neighborhoods and camps sheltering part of Marib's 2M+ displaced population; at least 4 wounded.

name: Saudi Landing Ship (Disputed), Off Mokha
detail: Houthis claim a Saudi military landing ship 'completely burned' with escort boats sunk/ablaze; Yemen's government disputes the vessel's identity. No Saudi confirmation — low confidence.

name: VLCC Amzan — Struck Off Yanbu
detail: Anti-ship ballistic missile hit the Saudi-flagged VLCC Amzan ~63nm west of Yanbu, sparking a main-deck fire; all crew safe, no environmental damage. Muted market reaction versus July's tanker strikes.
